dialogues.jp: 「さて……と。忘れ物はないな」
dialogues.en: The nurse opens the door for us and we walk to the hallway.
dialogues.text: The nurse opens the door for us and we walk to the hallway.

dialogues.jp:
およそ、１日と半日を過ごした部屋にお別れを
告げる時が来た。
dialogues.en: "Oh? Is that Moe-sempai? Hey, sempai!"
dialogues.text: "Oh? Is that Moe-sempai? Hey, sempai!"

dialogues.jp:
もう、午後も遅い。病院のあちこちを行ったり
来たりする身体検査は、割と時間がかかった。
dialogues.en: "Hey, young man, don't shout in the hospital."
dialogues.text: "Hey, young man, don't shout in the hospital."

dialogues.jp:
看護師さんがドアを開けてくれる。どうもと言
いつつ、廊下に出たときだった。
dialogues.en: "Oops, I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "Oops, I'm sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉くん……？　こんにちは。あら、そちら
　の方は……」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun......? Oh, hi. Who's this......?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun......? Oh, hi. Who's this......?"

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんに視線を向け、ちょこんと首を傾げる。
対する頼子さんは、恥ずかしいのか、俺の背中
に隠れてしまった。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai looks at Yoriko-san and tilts her head a little.
Yoriko-san, on the other hand, is being shy and hides behind
me.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai looks at Yoriko-san and tilts her head a little.
Yoriko-san, on the other hand, is being shy and hides behind
me.

dialogues.jp: 「ああ、えと、俺の友達」
dialogues.en: "Ah, she's a friend of mine."
dialogues.text: "Ah, she's a friend of mine."

dialogues.jp:
背中から出そうと横にカニ移動するのだが、頼
子さんも一緒に付いてくる。仕方ないな。
dialogues.en:
I lean over to one side to let her be seen, but Yoriko-san
leans to the same side as I did.
dialogues.text:
I lean over to one side to let her be seen, but Yoriko-san
leans to the same side as I did.

dialogues.jp: 「……｛さぎさわ／鷺澤｝さんっていうんだ」
dialogues.en: "......Her name is Sagisawa-san."
dialogues.text: "......Her name is Sagisawa-san."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　どうかした？」
dialogues.en: "What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "What's wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「いえ……私のお友達と同じ名前だったので、
　ちょっと驚いてしまったんです。その人は、
　鷺澤｛みさき／美咲｝さんというんですが」
dialogues.en:
"No, I was just a bit surprised because it's the same name
as a friend of mine. Her name is Misaki Sagisawa."
dialogues.text:
"No, I was just a bit surprised because it's the same name
as a friend of mine. Her name is Misaki Sagisawa."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「へえ。珍しい名前だし、もしかして親戚かも」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, really? Sagisawa isn't a very common name, so they may
be related."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, really? Sagisawa isn't a very common name, so they may
be related."

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩と頼子さん、等分に見ながら言う。頼子
さんは恥ずかしげに俯いているばかりだ。
dialogues.en:
I look at Moe-sempai and Yoriko-san. Yoriko-san is still
being shy and looking down at the floor.
dialogues.text:
I look at Moe-sempai and Yoriko-san. Yoriko-san is still
being shy and looking down at the floor.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「どうでしょうか……」
dialogues.en: "Could be......"
dialogues.text: "Could be......"

dialogues.jp:
眠たげに目を細める。いや、もしかしたら考え
ているのかもしれないが。
dialogues.en:
She narrows her eyes as if she's getting sleepy. Or maybe
she's just thinking...
dialogues.text:
She narrows her eyes as if she's getting sleepy. Or maybe
she's just thinking...

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「それより、朝倉くん、どうしたんですか？　
　入院してたんですか？」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, why are you here, Asakura-kun? Were you
hospitalized?"
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, why are you here, Asakura-kun? Were you
hospitalized?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、ちょっとね」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, I was."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, I was."

dialogues.jp: 俺は事の｛てんまつ／顛末｝を説明した。
dialogues.en: I tell her what happened.
dialogues.text: I tell her what happened.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「うふふ……朝倉くん、かっこいいですね。ニ
　ンジャみたいです」
dialogues.en:
"Teehee... Asakura-kun, you're so cool. You're like a
ninja."
dialogues.text:
"Teehee... Asakura-kun, you're so cool. You're like a
ninja."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「だとしたら、よっぽどの下忍だけどね」
dialogues.en: "If I am, I'm the worst ninja in Japan..."
dialogues.text: "If I am, I'm the worst ninja in Japan..."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「そんな事ないですよ。きっと、｛さるとびはっとり／猿飛服部｝です
　よ」
dialogues.en: "No, you're not. You're like the flying monkey, Hattori."
dialogues.text: "No, you're not. You're like the flying monkey, Hattori."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あ、それじゃ、私はこれで失礼しますね」
dialogues.en: "Well, I should be going."
dialogues.text: "Well, I should be going."

dialogues.jp:
ぺこりと丁寧にお辞儀すると、萌先輩は去って
いった。
dialogues.en: She bows nicely and leaves.
dialogues.text: She bows nicely and leaves.

dialogues.jp:
「……あ？　そういや、萌先輩は病院に何しに
　来たんだろ……？」
dialogues.en: "......Anyway what was she doing at this hospital......?"
dialogues.text: "......Anyway what was she doing at this hospital......?"

dialogues.speaker: Nurse
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、彼女だったら、よくお見舞いに見えて
　いるようだけど」
dialogues.en: "She comes here often to visit a patient."
dialogues.text: "She comes here often to visit a patient."

dialogues.speaker: Nurse
dialogues.jp: 「お見舞い？　へえ……」
dialogues.en: "Visiting a patient? Really...?"
dialogues.text: "Visiting a patient? Really...?"

dialogues.speaker: Nurse
dialogues.jp:
「何ていったかな……？　名前は忘れちゃった
　んだけど」
dialogues.en: "I cat't remember the patient's name......"
dialogues.text: "I cat't remember the patient's name......"

dialogues.speaker: Nurse
dialogues.jp:
「いいんすか？　看護師さんが患者さんの名前
　を忘れたりして」
dialogues.en: "Ooh! You don't remember the names of your patients?"
dialogues.text: "Ooh! You don't remember the names of your patients?"

dialogues.speaker: Nurse
dialogues.jp: 「私はむしろ、病状で把握していますから」
dialogues.en: "I remember them by their medical conditions."
dialogues.text: "I remember them by their medical conditions."

dialogues.jp: 澄ました顔で、指をピンと立てる。
dialogues.en: She points one finger upwards with a straight face.
dialogues.text: She points one finger upwards with a straight face.

dialogues.speaker: Nurse
dialogues.jp:
「その人は──おっとと、そんな事、軽々しく
　口にしちゃ駄目ね」
dialogues.en: "The patient is... Oops, I'm not supposed to tell you that."
dialogues.text: "The patient is... Oops, I'm not supposed to tell you that."

dialogues.jp: 立てた指を、唇の前に持っていった。
dialogues.en: She brings that same finger to her lips.
dialogues.text: She brings that same finger to her lips.

dialogues.jp: 「そりゃそうだ。じゃ、今度こそ失礼します」
dialogues.en: "You're right. Then, I should go for real this time."
dialogues.text: "You're right. Then, I should go for real this time."

dialogues.speaker: Nurse
dialogues.jp: 「良かったら、また来てね」
dialogues.en: "You can come back here any time you want."
dialogues.text: "You can come back here any time you want."

dialogues.speaker: Nurse
dialogues.jp: 「良くないでしょ、それは……」
dialogues.en: "I shouldn't come back......"
dialogues.text: "I shouldn't come back......"

dialogues.jp:
湿布の貼られた腰を軽く叩きながら、俺は病室
を後にしたのだった。
dialogues.en:
I gently pat at the heating pad on my back and leave the
room.
dialogues.text:
I gently pat at the heating pad on my back and leave the
room.

dialogues.jp: 「はあ〜あ、やっと外に出られたか」
dialogues.en: "I'm finally going home."
dialogues.text: "I'm finally going home."

dialogues.jp:
薬品臭さではなく、潮と花の香りのする空気を
いっぱいに吸い込み、ぐっと伸びをする。
dialogues.en:
I stretch and inhale fresh air, which smells of the sea and
flowers instead of medicine.
dialogues.text:
I stretch and inhale fresh air, which smells of the sea and
flowers instead of medicine.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、いたた……」

腰を押さえ｛うめ／呻｝く。と、頼子さんの心配そうな顔
が覗き込んできた。
dialogues.en:
I grab my back. Yoriko-san looks worried and peers at my
face.
dialogues.text:
I grab my back. Yoriko-san looks worried and peers at my
face.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫ですか……？」
dialogues.en: "Are you all right......?"
dialogues.text: "Are you all right......?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、平気平気。ちょっとした打ち身だって
　話だし。それより、頼子さんこそ、平気？」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah, I'm fine. They told me it's just a bruise. Anyway,
are you okay?"
dialogues.text:
"Yeah, I'm fine. They told me it's just a bruise. Anyway,
are you okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「何が……ですか？」
dialogues.en: "What about me?"
dialogues.text: "What about me?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「いや、外に出て。怖いって……そう言ってた
　でしょ？」
dialogues.en:
"You're outside now, you know. You're scared of the
outdoors, right?"
dialogues.text:
"You're outside now, you know. You're scared of the
outdoors, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、はい、でも……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, yes, but......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, yes, but......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「今日は、その……朝倉さんが居ますから……」
dialogues.en: "But you're with me today......"
dialogues.text: "But you're with me today......"

dialogues.jp:
繋がれた手に視線を落とし、頼子さんは軽く息
を呑んだ。
dialogues.en:
She looks down at her hand being held by mine, and catches
her breath.
dialogues.text:
She looks down at her hand being held by mine, and catches
her breath.

dialogues.jp: 「いいだろ？」
dialogues.en: "You don't mind, do you?"
dialogues.text: "You don't mind, do you?"

dialogues.jp:
照れくさくて、つい、ぶっきらぼうな口調になっ
てしまう。
dialogues.en: I'm embarrassed, so I said it brusquely.
dialogues.text: I'm embarrassed, so I said it brusquely.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「ま、まあ、こうした方が不安も減るだろうし、
　さ」
dialogues.en: "Y-You know, this will help to decrease your anxiety."
dialogues.text: "Y-You know, this will help to decrease your anxiety."

dialogues.jp:
言い訳のように早口に言う。というか、ほんと
のところ、８割方は言い訳にすぎない。
dialogues.en:
It sounds like I'm making an excuse. And the truth is that
80% of it was an excuse.
dialogues.text:
It sounds like I'm making an excuse. And the truth is that
80% of it was an excuse.

dialogues.jp: ただ、手を繋ぎたかった。
dialogues.en: I just wanted to hold her hand.
dialogues.text: I just wanted to hold her hand.

dialogues.jp:
好きな人の体温を、ただ身近に感じたかった。
それだけのことだ。
dialogues.en: I want to feel the warmth of the girl I love. That's it.
dialogues.text: I want to feel the warmth of the girl I love. That's it.

dialogues.jp:
桜の向こうに広がる青空を見ながら、ゆっくり
と歩いていく。
dialogues.en:
We walk slowly, looking at the blue sky through cherry
blossoms.
dialogues.text:
We walk slowly, looking at the blue sky through cherry
blossoms.

dialogues.jp:
天気のいい昼下がり。１日のうちでも、たぶん、
初音島がもっとも穏やかになる時間。
dialogues.en:
It's a beautiful afternoon. It's probably the most relaxing
time of the day on Hatsune Island.
dialogues.text:
It's a beautiful afternoon. It's probably the most relaxing
time of the day on Hatsune Island.

dialogues.jp:
ふと、この前見た夢の事を思い出した。こんな
風に毎日歩けたら、どんなに嬉しいだろう？
dialogues.en:
All of a sudden, I remember the dream I had before. It'd be
such fun if I could walk like this every day.
dialogues.text:
All of a sudden, I remember the dream I had before. It'd be
such fun if I could walk like this every day.

dialogues.jp:
「なあ、頼子さん。外が怖いのってもう治まっ
　た訳じゃないんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Yoriko-san, are you still scared to walk outside?"
dialogues.text: "Yoriko-san, are you still scared to walk outside?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、はい、その……まだです」
dialogues.en: "Ah, y-yes, I am...... still......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, y-yes, I am...... still......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「まだ……怖いです」
dialogues.en: "I'm still scared......"
dialogues.text: "I'm still scared......"

dialogues.jp:
それを示すように手にきゅっと力が込められる。
応えるように、俺も握り返す。
dialogues.en:
As if showing how scared she still is, she squeezes my hand
tightly. So I squeeze her hand back.
dialogues.text:
As if showing how scared she still is, she squeezes my hand
tightly. So I squeeze her hand back.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「事故の報せを受けた時……私、もう、何も分
　からなくなってしまいました……」
dialogues.en:
"When I received a call about your accident...... I didn't
know what to do......"
dialogues.text:
"When I received a call about your accident...... I didn't
know what to do......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「目の前が真っ暗で……息が苦しくて……身体
　が震えて……寒くて……汗びっしょりで……」
dialogues.en:
"My vision got dark...... I couldn't breathe...... my body
was shaking...... I was cold, and I started to sweat......"
dialogues.text:
"My vision got dark...... I couldn't breathe...... my body
was shaking...... I was cold, and I started to sweat......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「行かなくちゃ、行かなくちゃって……病院に
　それだけで頭がいっぱいで……。だから、外
　に出られたんだと思います……」
dialogues.en:
"I couldn't think of anything else but going to the
hospital...... I had to go to the hospital...... So that's
why I could go outside, I guess."
dialogues.text:
"I couldn't think of anything else but going to the
hospital...... I had to go to the hospital...... So that's
why I could go outside, I guess."

dialogues.jp: 頼子さんは｛かす／微｝かに笑みを浮かべた。
dialogues.en: She smiles slightly.
dialogues.text: She smiles slightly.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「初めは、いつもの服で外に出たんですよ。で
　も……途中で、お借りした服があったのを思
　い出して……」
dialogues.en:
"I went outside with my maid uniform first. But...... then I
remembered you let me wear your clothes last time......"
dialogues.text:
"I went outside with my maid uniform first. But...... then I
remembered you let me wear your clothes last time......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「やっぱり……ご迷惑ですものね……あの服で
　行ったら……」
dialogues.en:
"I thought you'd be embarrassed if I showed up in those maid
clothes......"
dialogues.text:
"I thought you'd be embarrassed if I showed up in those maid
clothes......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「迷惑って事はさ、ないんだよ」
dialogues.en: "I wouldn't be embarrassed."
dialogues.text: "I wouldn't be embarrassed."

dialogues.jp: 詩の朗読のように、くっきりと言う。
dialogues.en: I say it clearly, like I was reading a line of a book.
dialogues.text: I say it clearly, like I was reading a line of a book.

dialogues.jp:
「頼子さんなら。俺にとっては。……来てくれ
　て、凄い、嬉しかった」
dialogues.en:
"If it's you... to me...... I was just so happy that you
came to see me..."
dialogues.text:
"If it's you... to me...... I was just so happy that you
came to see me..."

dialogues.jp: 何となく立ち止まり、間近に視線を絡め合う。
dialogues.en: We stop and look at each other.
dialogues.text: We stop and look at each other.

dialogues.jp:
背後──桜の並木が、単なるピンクの｛にじ／滲｝みになっ
て、ただ、頼子さんの瞳だけを意識する。
dialogues.en:
All the cherry blossoms fade into the background as I look
into Yoriko's eyes.
dialogues.text:
All the cherry blossoms fade into the background as I look
into Yoriko's eyes.

dialogues.jp:
昨日の号泣の腫れもすっかり引いて、湖のよう
な静けさと深さを｛たた／湛｝えた瞳。
dialogues.en:
The puffiness of her eyes from crying so much yesterday is
gone now, and her eyes look quiet and deep like a lake.
dialogues.text:
The puffiness of her eyes from crying so much yesterday is
gone now, and her eyes look quiet and deep like a lake.

dialogues.jp: 急に恥ずかしくなり、俺は冗談でごまかした。
dialogues.en: I suddenly get shy, so I hide my embarrassment with a joke.
dialogues.text: I suddenly get shy, so I hide my embarrassment with a joke.

dialogues.jp:
「例えば、貝のビキニの水着を着て街中を｛かっぽ／闊歩｝
　したとしても、だ」
dialogues.en:
"Even if you wore a bikini made of seashells and walk around
the town, I wouldn't be embarrassed."
dialogues.text:
"Even if you wore a bikini made of seashells and walk around
the town, I wouldn't be embarrassed."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「え？　え？　何ですか……？」
dialogues.en: "What? What? What do you mean......?"
dialogues.text: "What? What? What do you mean......?"

dialogues.jp:
通じなかった冗談は、春風に乗って、桜と一緒
に飛び散っていった。
dialogues.en:
She didn't understand my joke... The joke was blown away by
the spring wind together with petals of cherry blossoms.
dialogues.text:
She didn't understand my joke... The joke was blown away by
the spring wind together with petals of cherry blossoms.

dialogues.jp: ◆退院◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
本日退院の俺、病室を出た俺と頼子さんは、萌
先輩に出会った。
dialogues.en:
It's time for me to say good-bye to the room where I spent a
day and a half.
dialogues.text:
It's time for me to say good-bye to the room where I spent a
day and a half.

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩には頼子さんと同じ苗字の友達がいるら
しい。鷺澤なんて珍しい苗字だよな……。
dialogues.en:
It's already late afternoon. It took me a while to go from
place to place in the hospital to finish all the medical
checkups.
dialogues.text:
It's already late afternoon. It took me a while to go from
place to place in the hospital to finish all the medical
checkups.

dialogues.jp:
帰り道、頼子さんと手をつなぎ歩く。「外は怖
くないのか？」ときくと、今は俺がいるから平
気と言ってくれた。
dialogues.en: "Thank you so much for everything."
dialogues.text: "Thank you so much for everything."

dialogues.jp:
外に出るのをあんなに怖がっていた頼子さんが、
俺の為に病院まで来てくれた。
dialogues.en: I bow to the nurse. Yoriko-san follows suit.
dialogues.text: I bow to the nurse. Yoriko-san follows suit.

dialogues.jp: それが嬉しかった。
dialogues.en: "Take care of yourself."
dialogues.text: "Take care of yourself."
